Represents 12,576 shares of common stock received by Naneva Capital LLC ("Naneva") on April 30, 2026 in a pro rata distribution, for no consideration, by BSG Series CM, LLC ("BSG") of all shares of common stock of the issuer held by BSG to its members in accordance with their respective percentage membership interests. The reporting person owns a 90% membership interest in Naneva, and the reporting person's spouse owns the remaining 10% membership interest in Naneva. The reporting person disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares held by Naneva except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
